note: Ground truth for internal/eval.NDCG. Regenerate with gen_ndcg_reference.py; see that file for why each case exists. A case with ndcg == null was skipped by trec_eval entirely.

cases.name: perfect
cases.why: ideal order scores exactly 1.0 whatever the gain function is

cases.name: swapped_grades
cases.why: discriminates exponential gain from linear: 0.7967 vs 0.8597

cases.name: unjudged_at_top
cases.why: an unjudged doc at rank 1 must push a and b down a slot, not vanish

cases.name: judged_zero_at_top
cases.why: judged-irrelevant must behave identically to unjudged_at_top

cases.name: all_unjudged
cases.why: retrieving nothing judged is 0.0, not an error

cases.name: no_relevant
cases.why: IDCG == 0. trec_eval's answer here is the one we cannot guess

cases.name: short_run
cases.why: IDCG counts relevant docs we never retrieved: 1/2.1309

cases.name: relevant_at_11
cases.why: rank 11 is past the cut and must contribute nothing

cases.name: relevant_at_10
cases.why: the boundary the case above brackets: rank 10 does count

cases.name: ideal_beyond_k
cases.why: IDCG truncated at k, else nDCG can never reach 1.0 on a deep pool

cases.name: graded_mixed
cases.why: the realistic shape: grades, zeros and unjudged interleaved

cases.name: negative_grade
cases.why: a -1 grade must behave as 0, matching unjudged_at_top exactly
